description: This file defines a configuration structure and parsing logic for a 'Talk Mode Gateway' in a Swift-based application. It includes a state struct that encapsulates configuration options, and a parser enum that processes a configuration snapshot to produce this state, handling defaults and environment overrides.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a configuration snapshot to create a TalkModeGatewayConfigState, considering defaults and environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides a default configuration state when parsing is not possible or desired.
